name: tokenfault-monorepo
description: TokenFault — debugging, observability and fault-injection toolkit for AI streaming applications.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && pnpm -r --parallel run typecheck && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm smoke && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
